description: This file defines the Lesson class, representing a micro-lesson entity with properties such as id, title, description, duration, level, tags, content, and an optional thumbnail URL. It includes a getter for a human-readable duration string.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: A micro-lesson entity with minimal content blocks, including properties for its identifier, title, description, duration, level, tags, content blocks, and optional thumbnail URL.

methods.name: Lesson (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Lesson instance with required fields: id, title, description, durationMinutes, level, tags, content, and optional thumbnailUrl.

methods.name: prettyDuration
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the lesson's duration, e.g., '5 min'.
